2607.05468.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
2607.05468.paper_summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual future dynamics and executable action sequences. However, existing video-action co-training methods primarily optimize appearance-oriented video latents, which may insufficiently capture the temporally evolving geometry required for precise manipulation. We propose MECo-WAM, a Multi-Expert Co-Training World Action Model that injects action-relevant 4D geometric priors into video-action representations while preserving the original lightweight inference graph. During training, MECo-WAM combines video and action experts with a lightweight 4D expert supervised by relational targets from a frozen VGGT encoder. Asymmetric expert visibility prevents non-causal shortcuts from auxiliary geometry to action generation. To transfer geometric knowledge into the deployed video-action pathway, we introduce decayed 4D read-mask attention, which provides restricted current-frame geometric guidance early in training and progressively removes this dependency. We further propose action-aware temporal geometric distillation, which aligns within-frame geometric relations and their temporal evolution while emphasizing visual regions most relevant to robot actions. At deployment, all auxiliary 4D components are removed. Experiments on LIBERO (98.2%), RoboTwin 2.0 (92.6%), and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that MECo-WAM improves manipulation performance without increasing inference cost.
2607.05468.paper_summary_zh: 世界行動模型（WAMs）顯示出在機器人操作方面的強大潛力，通過共同建模視覺未來動態和可執行的行動序列。然而，現有的視頻-行動共同訓練方法主要優化以外觀為導向的視頻潛在特徵，這可能不足以捕捉精確操作所需的時間演變幾何。 我們提出了MECo-WAM，一種多專家共同訓練世界行動模型，將與行動相關的4D幾何先驗注入視頻-行動表示中，同時保留原始的輕量級推理圖。在訓練過程中，MECo-WAM結合視頻和行動專家，並使用由凍結的VGGT編碼器提供關聯目標的輕量級4D專家。非對稱專家可見性防止了從輔助幾何到行動生成的非因果捷徑。為了將幾何知識轉移到部署的視頻-行動路徑中，我們引入了衰減的4D讀取遮罩注意力，這在訓練初期提供了受限的當前幀幾何指導，並逐步去除這一依賴。我們進一步提出了行動感知的時間幾何蒸餾，該方法對齊幀內幾何關係及其時間演變，同時強調與機器人行動最相關的視覺區域。在部署時，所有輔助的4D組件都被移除。在LIBERO（98.2%）、RoboTwin 2.0（92.6%）和具有挑戰性的現實世界操作任務上的實驗顯示，MECo-WAM在不增加推理成本的情況下提高了操作性能。
